bull_bear.body:
- Core capital commitment is "No incremental equity for 3 years" / "No dilution through FY29", self-funded via annuity cash ROA; the deck states "Improved quality of earnings leading to capital accretion and no requirement to raise equity" and "the Company would maintain healthy capital adequacy with no incremental capital required".
- Capital position as of Jun'26: CAR 21.0% (vs 21.2% at Mar'26), net worth INR 2,976 Cr, leverage 3.6x (3.7x in Q4'FY26), and a liquidity buffer of cash and cash equivalents of INR 1,864 Cr.
- Steady-state target ROA of 3.0-3.5% by FY29 against a current ROA of 2.8% and ROE of 9.2%; the deck frames the model as "Self-sustained, annuity-led returns targeting steady-state profitability".
- Liability book: total debt INR 10,793 Cr, diversified by lender (Banks 45%, Capital Markets & Others 23%, DFI 15%, NBFC 9%, FIs 8%) and by product (Term Loan 53%, NCD 23%, ECB 14%, Others 8%, CP 2%), with "~66% of the borrowings now beyond three years", described as materially mitigating refinancing risk.
- Promoter and Management to potentially own approx. 9.6 Mn shares on a fully diluted basis, with tenure-linked vesting over 3 years from grant date; ESOPs are 3.3% of fully diluted capital.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Strategic realignment announced 7 February 2026 "resetting our asset-sourcing strategy, re-base opex and strengthen the earnings profile, thereby delivering self-sustained profitability metrics": ramp high-yielding Emerging Market and Embedded Finance, exit Prime Market high-ticket low-yield verticals (DSA Channel).
- Pre- vs post-realignment framing: portfolio moves from a mix of lower-yield intermediated Prime (Business Loans, Machinery, Prime LAP) plus higher-yield EM LAP and Embedded Merchant Finance, to "Higher-yield focus verticals" alone at "Yield ~18-26%"; income profile moves from "upfront DA / Co-lending income - front-loaded and non-recurring" to "a more predictable earnings quality".
- Emerging Market LAP is described as "Small-ticket, collateral-backed loans to MSMEs in Tier-2 cities & beyond" serving "highly underserved and underpenetrated Tier-2 cities and beyond"; Embedded Merchant Finance is "Tech-led, fully-automated merchant lending on the GROx platform (ex-MyShubhLife)".
- Governance framing: "Institutionally Owned: Majority held by Institutional Investors" with promoter at 2.8% fully diluted, and AoA-enshrined protections - independent directors to comprise a majority in perpetuity, any shareholder holding >10% qualifies for a board seat, removal of key management (including CRO, CFO) requires 3/4th board approval, and special resolution required for any AoA change so "Promoters/Management do not have unfettered rights to divert business strategy".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Merger] "Stock exchange approval for PCPL merger received in Q1'FY27. Application for NCLT approval has been filed"; the cost base is described as structurally leaner "post Prime exit, Profectus acquisition and branch optimisation". The deck does not state PCPL's full name, consideration or expected completion date.
- [Rebranding] "MyShubhLife" has been rebranded as GROx, the Embedded Merchant Finance platform.
- [Asset quality] Overall GNPA (AUM) 2.6% at Jun'26 vs 2.5% at Mar'26 and 2.5% at Jun'25, NNPA (AUM) 1.9%, provision coverage ratio 45% (down from 47% through Mar'25-Dec'25); both focus verticals carry GNPA of 2.1% while de-focused products carry 3.1% ("Impact of AUM rundown"). GROx GNPA rose steadily from 0.2% (Mar-25) to 2.1% (Jun-26). Collection efficiency 98% in Q1'FY27.
- [Tax] "Tax expense for Q1'FY27 is negative as the Company transitioned to new tax regime effective FY27, lowering the marginal tax rate to 25.17% and delivering a one-time tax windfall through reversal of Deferred Tax Liability" - so the 2.8% PAT/ROA is flattered by a one-off and sits above the 2.6% pre-tax ROA.
- [Board] Board is chaired by Non-Executive Chairman Satyananda Mishra (ex-Chairman MCX, ex-CIC GOI, ex-Director SIDBI), with independent directors including Karnam Sekar (ex-MD & CEO Indian Overseas Bank), Hemant Bhargava (ex-Chairman in charge and MD, LIC), Rajeev K. Agarwal (ex-Whole Time Member, SEBI), S. Karuppasamy (ex-Executive Director, RBI) and Tabassum Inamdar; Shachindra Nath is Founder & MD and Anuj Pandey is CEO; statutory auditor is G.P. Kapadia & Co.

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions UGRO as a data-tech MSME lender "Building an Institution for MSME Lending", mid-way through a February-2026 strategic realignment that exits low-yield intermediated Prime lending and re-bases the book on two higher-yield focus verticals - Emerging Market small-ticket LAP and Embedded Merchant Finance (GROx) - on a structurally leaner cost base and with no incremental equity through FY29.

rows.text: circulates the notices convening **separate meetings of equity shareholders and secured and unsecured creditors** for its amalgamation with **Profectus Capital**, under an **NCLT order of 6 August**; a procedural step, with no new terms.
